title: Discord bot receives messages with an empty content string and no embeds or attachments
symptoms: message.content is an empty string for messages from other users
channel.messages.fetch returns messages with empty content even with Administrator
Prefix commands such as !help stop responding while slash commands still work
cause: Message content is a privileged intent. Without MESSAGE_CONTENT, Discord blanks content, embeds, attachments, components and poll on other users' messages, except in DMs, messages that mention the bot, and messages used with a message context menu command.
fix: Turn on Message Content Intent in the Developer Portal and also request the intent in code. Apps in 100 or more servers must be verified and approved for it.
apply: const client = new Client({ intents: [GatewayIntentBits.Guilds, GatewayIntentBits.GuildMessages, GatewayIntentBits.MessageContent] });
affected: Discord API v10 gateway, every bot without MESSAGE_CONTENT, as of 2026-10
